definition.name: NXxas

symbols.doc: The symbol(s) listed here will be used below to coordinate datasets with the same shape.

symbol.name: nP
symbol.doc: Number of stacked spectra (scan points). This is the growable first dimension: data could be appended along it during acquisition. It is absent when a single spectrum is stored.

symbol.name: dataRank
symbol.doc: Rank of the ``intensity`` field: 1 for a single spectrum ``[nEnergy]`` or 2 for a stack of spectra ``[nP, nEnergy]``.

definition.doc: This is a generic application definition for X-ray absorption spectroscopy. Technique-specific application definitions extend this base definition.

field.name: definition
field.doc: Official NeXus NXDL schema to which this file conforms.

field.name: title
field.doc: Human-readable title for the measurement or calculation.

field.name: start_time
field.doc: Start time of the measurement. Omit for calculated or reconstructed spectra.

field.name: is_experimental
field.doc: Specify if the data comes from an experiment. Use ``true`` for data acquired at a beamline or laboratory instrument, and ``false`` for spectra calculated/simulated using a computational tool, reconstructed from a linear combination of reference components, etc. Record provenance in the :ref:`processing </NXxas/ENTRY/processing-group>` group.

group.name: element
group.doc: The element being probed by the incident X-rays.

group.name: edge
group.doc: The absorption edge being probed, defined by the principal quantum number and orbital symmetry of the photoionized electron (for example ``K``, ``L1``, ``L2``, ``L3``, or the combined ``L2,3``). Together with the element, it uniquely identifies the probed electronic transition.

field.name: energy
field.doc: The energy axis of the spectrum.

field.name: intensity
field.doc: The intensity of the spectrum. The precise definition of what is meant by intensity depends on the acquisition mode, and will be specified by each subclass application definition.

dimensions.doc: ``dataRank`` is 1 for a single spectrum, shape ``[nEnergy]``, or 2 for a stack of ``nP`` spectra, shape ``[nP, nEnergy]``.

field.name: intensity_errors
field.doc: The estimated uncertainty associated with each ``intensity`` value, expressed as a standard deviation.

dimensions.doc: Same shape as ``intensity``: ``[nEnergy]`` when ``dataRank`` is 1, or ``[nP, nEnergy]`` when ``dataRank`` is 2.

field.name: temperature
field.doc: Sample temperature, one value per spectrum.

dimensions.doc: ``[nP]``, matching the leading ``nP`` axis of ``intensity``. ``nP`` is 1 for a single spectrum.

group.name: DATA

attribute.name: signal
attribute.doc: Name of the field to plot: the absorption ``intensity``.

group.doc:
Plot of the X-ray absorption ``intensity`` versus ``energy``.
For a single spectrum ``intensity`` is ``[nEnergy]`` with ``energy`` as the only axis (``@energy_indices = 0``). For a stack it is ``[nP, nEnergy]``: ``energy`` has ``@energy_indices = 1`` and the quantity that varies across the stack (a time series, a spatial map, an operando series, ...) is the leading axis with ``@AXISNAME_indices = 0``.
That quantity is stored in its standard NeXus location (for example ``NXsample/temperature``, ``NXsample/electric_field``, an ``NXsample/NXtransformations`` axis, or an ``NXbeam`` polarization field) and linked here. The application definition does not enumerate these coordinates: any of them, including ones not listed, is declared by adding the field in its base-class location and wiring it into this group.

group.name: raw_data
group.doc: Raw data as written by the acquisition or simulation software, preserved without modification.

group.name: processing
group.doc:
Provenance of :ref:`intensity </NXxas/ENTRY/intensity-field>`.
For measured spectra, include all processing steps from measured data to the reported spectrum. For calculated spectra, describe the calculation. For linear combinations, identify the reference components and their weights.

field.name: version
field.doc: Version of the program identified by ``program``.

group.name: parameters
group.doc: Processing parameter values. Include a ``units`` attribute for each parameter where applicable.

group.name: note
group.doc: Instructions for reproducing the spectrum. Identify the input data and give the processing steps in order.

field.name: type
field.doc: MIME content type of ``data``. Use ``text/x-python`` for Python code. Use ``text/plain`` for a description of the processing steps.

field.name: data
field.doc: Note content in the format specified by ``type``.

group.name: reference
group.doc: An independent reference spectrum, for example a metal-foil standard used for energy calibration. Store the reference here when it is a complete spectrum in its own right, in particular when it probes a different absorbing element or absorption edge, or when it is measured in a different acquisition mode than the main spectrum (for example a foil measured in transmission while the sample is measured in fluorescence).

field.name: definition
field.doc: Official NeXus NXDL schema to which this subentry conforms. Should be an ``NXxas``-family definition.
